question: Israel military action against Syria by October 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if an Israeli air strike or surface-to-surface missile strike directly impacts Syria by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM Syria time. Intercepted munitions do not count. Resolves with Polymarket market israel-military-action-against-syria-by-october-31-2026.

history.rationale: Sprint forecast for fast resolutions. No independent news view: this is the market price 8.1% with the standing favorite-longshot rule (prices under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, in between left as is). It tests whether that rule beats the market.
10/27/2026 update, same method as the sprint: market price 11.9% with the favorite-longshot rule (under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, floor 1%). No independent news view.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved no. Our last number was 11.9%; the market's last saved price before archival was 2.35%. Brier 0.014.
